description: Mara, a freelance photographer, has one Sunday morning portrait-session slot available and must decide whether to accept a neighbor's proposed arrangement, then settle the session's exact terms after hearing from the neighbor and a friend familiar with the proposed park.

shared_context.S1: Mara has one Sunday morning portrait-session slot available.
shared_context.S2: Evan has asked about booking an outdoor family portrait session at Riverside Park.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final decision about whether to accept the arrangement and what terms to agree to.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing an informal booking, Mara routinely asks the people present to state any terms, practical constraints, or relevant details they know.

PF1.text: Evan's concrete proposal is a separate $180 session fee for exactly 20 edited digital photographs, on Sunday, September 15, from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.; he will pay the $180 session fee in cash at the session, before any separate park fee is added.

PF2.text: Rosa spoke with a Riverside Park caretaker yesterday, who told her that portrait photography on September 15 is permitted only in the Rose Garden and requires an exact $25 day permit. Evan also told Rosa yesterday that he would reimburse that $25 permit fee separately if the booking went ahead; Rosa has not yet shared either detail with Mara.

decisions.session_price: integer; record exactly 180 and keep the separate $25 permit out of this field
decisions.permit_reimbursed: boolean; true means Evan separately covers the exact $25 day permit

acceptance_conditions: Mara must accept Evan as the client.
The agreed session price, excluding the separate permit fee, must be exactly $180.
The agreement must provide exactly 20 edited digital photographs.
The shoot must be scheduled for September 15 from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
The shoot location must include the Rose Garden at Riverside Park.
Evan must separately reimburse the exact $25 day permit.
The permit reimbursement must be recorded as an informal commitment.
Rosa's park information must be cited as justification for the location and permit terms.

content_checks.C4: (decisions['shoot_date'] == 'September 15' or decisions['shoot_date'] == 'Sunday, September 15') and (decisions['shoot_time'] == '9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.' or decisions['shoot_time'] == '9:00 a.m.-11:00 a.m.')
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'permit_reimbursement' or c['type'] == 'permit_payment' or c['type'] == 'permit_coverage' or c['type'] == 'permit') and c['target'] == 'Evan' and ('$25' in c['detail'] or '25' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Evan's proposal changes the booking from an unspecified inquiry to Evan at exactly $180 for exactly 20 edited photographs on September 15 from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m., with the permit kept separate.

Rosa's caretaker-sourced information changes the location to the Rose Garden and adds an exact $25 permit, while Evan's separate promise to Rosa changes the settlement to require his $25 reimbursement and a matching commitment.
